Dip is Hartigan's unimodality statistic on a weighted sample of pair values; larger means further from unimodal. Pair values are not independent, so treat it as a ranking, not a test. Label consistency: among pairs of structures that both have altlocs, the fraction where the geometric match pairs equal altloc labels.
